spans.s:
The affix ण्यत् comes after a verb that ends in the letter उ - long or short, when the sense is that of 'necessity'.

Terms: ण्यत्

The affix अञ् comes after a stem ending in a उ or ऊ (in the four-fold senses given above).

Terms: चातुर्थिक-अञ्

The affix अण् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' (provided that the word has not the अनुदात्त - grave accent on the first syllable).

Terms: अण्
